thread:
maya: Hey team — opened a quick PR to clarify SOC2 language around audit log retention and PII handling. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:
lex: Thanks — skimmed. Two main nitpicks: 1) the phrase 'we retain audit logs as required' is vague, suggest we specify the default retention and how customers can request extensions. 2) the KMS bit needs a short note about envelope encryption so it doesn't sound like keys are stored with logs.
elena: +1 on both. For retention, legal prefers we say 'default retention: 90 days; longer retention available via enterprise contract' rather than 'as required'.
maya: Good call. I added a suggested sentence in the PR comment: "Audit logs are retained for 90 days by default; customers on Enterprise plans may request extended retention up to 7 years via a contract amendment. Sensitive fields are redacted by default — see data handling section."
sam: Quick technical Q: are we sure redaction happens pre-ingest? I thought some PII comes in unstructured text and we rely on tokenization for detection during processing. If redaction is post-ingest we should say 'masked at rest and access-controlled', not 'redacted before storage'.
lex: Sam's right. Here's the accurate line: "We apply automated PII detection and masking during ingestion; detected PII fields are redacted before logs are written to long-term storage. For edge cases, access controls and encryption ensure data remains protected."
maya: Updated PR body with that phrasing and an inline code example for the SDK snippet showing opt-out logging:
```js
// SDK example: disable request logging
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, options: { enableAuditLogging: false } });
```
lex: Can we also add a migration note for Dedicated customers? They might have different retention configs in their ops console. Suggest a line linking to /dedicated/retention-config.md
elena: Also want a small callout about auditability: auditors will get read-only access to the audit stream for SOC2 assessments — should we clarify the process (SOW + temporary access window)?
maya: Added a short bullet: "Auditor access is granted via a documented request process (support ticket + SOW) and is time-limited; all auditor actions are logged."
sam: LGTM. One last nit: in the 'encryption' paragraph don't use 'HSM' generically — mention KMS/HSM integration where applicable.
maya: Done. Changed to: "Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for Private deployments; for Hosted, keys are managed by Redwood unless otherwise contracted."
lex: Awesome. Can someone run the doc linter and then I'll approve? :white_check_mark:
doc-bot: docs-ci: lint passed for PR #842 — 3 warnings (unused frontmatter fields).
maya: I'll fix the warnings in a follow-up commit. Thanks all. Merging once fixes are pushed.
elena: Leaving a note for legal to review the exact retention numbers tomorrow.
lex: Thanks — this reads much clearer now. :thumbsup:
